title: Validate manual preloading draft quantities and products before operational commitment
description: Close the manual preloading gap before explicit demand is attached. Create/Update calls scope, booking and PreLoadingSalesOrderLinkRules, but that rule returns when linked.Count==0. Calculate directly sums Cartons/Weight/Volume. Manual rows therefore bypass positive quantity/live product and nonnegative carton/weight/volume checks and can persist invalid arithmetic. Add shared ContainerLoadingDraftValidationRules through existing layers and invoke after authorization before source commitment/numbering/persistence; revalidate in existing submit/approve locks, and at existing conversion if a downstream loading draft is produced. Preserve header-only update semantics and explicit SourceSalesOrderDetailId links without silently clearing them. Use actual EF precision/scale and existing unit normalization; validate calculated line/header quantities, weights, volumes and monetary totals for representability/overflow before numbering/writes. Preserve supported empty draft headers; operational submit/approve requires valid nonempty lines. Keep supported repeated product rows and cumulative source quantities. Validate the rows actually persisted after existing server-owned child identity/deleted-flag normalization: client IsDeleted must never hide a bad row that is then reactivated. Keep historical snapshots readable and cancellation/reversal usable; no new validation gate on those historical undo paths. No schema/migration, currency/unit mixing, business permission change or implicit inventory/finance posting. Adapt every related original unit/SQL fixture only with genuine existing identities/grants/live masters, retain all business assertions. Explicit logs/TRX/results .ai/logs/<task> only; preserve full original failures. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Every persisted manual or linked preloading row requires live enabled product, positive representable quantity and nonnegative representable cartons/weight/volume, with totals validated against actual EF bounds before writes/numbering. Preserve currently supported empty drafts and repeated products, existing header-only updates and source visibility.

Operational submit/approve/conversion revalidates effective stored rows under existing booking/preloading/source locks and existing menu/customer authority. Keep demand remaining-capacity/base-unit rules, explicit source links and historical cancellation; reject atomically without number/status/detail/demand/stock/finance changes.

Rules/controller and real isolated SQL regressions cover unlinked and linked drafts, deleted/disabled/missing products, zero/negative/overflow values and totals, client deleted-flag bypass, master invalidation, header-only updates retaining links, valid commitment and denied zero writes. Preserve original preloading booking/demand/source regressions and safe Release/full units.
implementation_evidence: ContainerPreLoadingController.Create:73-108 validates scopes/booking/demand then forces child IsDeleted=false and Calculate; Calculate:604 only sums Cartons/Weight/Volume. PreLoadingSalesOrderLinkRules:302-312 immediately returns for linked.Count==0, so positive quantity/product checks of linked sources do not cover manual lines. ERP-363/368/372/485 covers locks/link/canonical form, not manual numeric/master integrity.
